text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any mucus? If so, what color is the mucus and how much do you cough up? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragm, no acute infiltrates.

speaker: Doctor
text: That X-ray suggests air trapping, which is often seen in obstructive lung diseases. Do you experience wheezing when you breathe out, and does your cough worsen at night or after exposure to cold air? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Doctor

Has your condition been present for more than a year, and do you notice a decline in lung function during certain seasons or when exposed to smoke? REQUEST TEST: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Level
